INSERT INTO prices (delivery_start, delivery_end, price_eur_mwh, area)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
            ON CONFLICT (delivery_start, area)
            DO UPDATE SET delivery_end = EXCLUDED.delivery_end,
                          price_eur_mwh = EXCLUDED.price_eur_mwh,
                          fetched_at = NOW()
